title.ko: 학술적 헤징: seem to · tend to · may well · it could be argued that
title.en: academic hedging: seem to, tend to, may well, it could be argued that

explain.ko: 학술 글에서는 결과를 단정하지 않고 헤징(hedging)으로 불확실성을 표현합니다. 동사(seem, appear, suggest, tend to), 조동사(may, might, could), 부사(possibly, arguably, generally), 형용사(likely, probable), 구(to some extent, by and large, it could be argued that)를 사용합니다. 헤징은 주장을 약하게 만드는 것이 아니라 증거의 정도를 정확히 반영하는 방법입니다. 한계를 인정하는 문장도 학술적 신뢰를 높입니다.
explain.en: Academic writing avoids categorical claims and uses hedging to signal uncertainty. Tools include verbs (seem, appear, suggest, tend to), modals (may, might, could), adverbs (possibly, arguably, generally), adjectives (likely, probable) and phrases (to some extent, by and large, it could be argued that). Hedging does not weaken a claim; it matches it to the strength of the evidence. Acknowledging limitations also boosts credibility.

lines.t: This lecture covers how to avoid categorical claims in academic writing. Scholars by and large use expressions such as can, may and tend to. This keeps claims from being exaggerated and leaves room for counter-arguments.

trans.ko: 이 강의에서는 학술적 글쓰기에서 단정을 피하는 방법을 다룹니다. 학자들은 대체로 can, may, tend to 같은 표현을 사용합니다. 이렇게 하면 주장이 과장되지 않고, 반론 가능성도 열어 둘 수 있습니다.

lines.t: How should I write my conclusion?
Don't be too categorical. Write something like 'appears to be effective'.
Should I mention limitations as well?
Of course. State limitations such as sample size clearly.

trans.ko:

prompt.ko: 학술적 헤징을 사용해 연구 결과나 사회 현상에 대한 주장을 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences giving cautious claims about research findings or a social phenomenon using hedging.

task.model: The findings appear to suggest that exercise can improve learning. Students tend to concentrate better when they exercise regularly. However, because the sample is small, the results should be interpreted with caution to some extent. It could be argued that further research is needed.

model_trans.ko: 이 연구 결과는 운동이 학습 능력을 높일 수 있음을 시사하는 것으로 보입니다. 학생들은 규칙적으로 운동할 때 집중력이 높아지는 경향이 있습니다. 그러나 표본이 작기 때문에 결과를 어느 정도 조심스럽게 해석해야 합니다. 추가 연구가 필요하다고 주장할 수 있습니다.
model_trans.en: The findings appear to suggest that exercise can improve learning. Students tend to concentrate better when they exercise regularly. However, because the sample is small, the results should be interpreted with caution to some extent. It could be argued that further research is needed.
